<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=244, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden chick</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:white}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244,240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffefd);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122,122,120,-120,1,1600);
ref.position.set(0,120,640);
ref.lookAt(0,120,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();

const V = (x,h,z) => new THREE.Vector3(x-122,240-h,z);
const mix = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
function smooth(lo,hi,v) {
  const t=clamp((v-lo)/(hi-lo),0,1);
  return t*t*(3-2*t);
}
function group(parent,name,origin) {
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.userData.origin=origin.clone();
  g.position.copy(origin);
  if(parent.userData.origin) g.position.sub(parent.userData.origin);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const down=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.97});
function paint(color,roughness=.92) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness});
}
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,36,28);
function ellipsoid(parent,name,center,radii,material,rotation) {
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(sphere,material);
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.position.copy(center).sub(parent.userData.origin);
  mesh.scale.set(...radii);
  if(rotation) mesh.rotation.set(...rotation);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function sample(rows,h,k) {
  if(h<=rows[0][0]) return rows[0][k];
  let i=0;
  while(i+1<rows.length && rows[i+1][0]<h) ++i;
  if(i+1===rows.length) return rows[i][k];
  const a=rows[i],b=rows[i+1],p=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],q=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
  const span=b[0]-a[0],t=(h-a[0])/span,t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  const m=(b[k]-p[k])/(b[0]-p[0]),n=(q[k]-a[k])/(q[0]-a[0]);
  return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*a[k]+(t3-2*t2+t)*span*m+
         (-2*t3+3*t2)*b[k]+(t3-t2)*span*n;
}
function profileRing(rows,h) {
  return [sample(rows,h,1),h,sample(rows,h,2),sample(rows,h,3),sample(rows,h,4)];
}
function ringPoint(r,a) {
  return V(r[0]+r[2]*Math.sin(a),r[1],r[4]+r[3]*Math.cos(a));
}
function skin(parent,name,start,end,nrings,ring,color,limits) {
  const pos=[],norm=[],col=[],index=[];
  const slices=80;
  for(let j=0;j<=nrings;j++) {
    const u=mix(start,end,j/nrings);
    const r=ring(u);
    const eps=(limits[1]-limits[0])*.00012;
    const before=ring(Math.max(limits[0],u-eps)),after=ring(Math.min(limits[1],u+eps));
    for(let i=0;i<=slices;i++) {
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/slices;
      const pt=ringPoint(r,a);
      const tangent=new THREE.Vector3(r[2]*Math.cos(a),0,-r[3]*Math.sin(a));
      const n=ringPoint(after,a).sub(ringPoint(before,a)).cross(tangent).normalize();
      const c=color(u,a,pt.x+122);
      pos.push(...pt.sub(parent.userData.origin).toArray());
      norm.push(...n.toArray());
      col.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<nrings && i<slices) {
        const k=j*(slices+1)+i,l=k+slices+1;
        index.push(k,l,k+1,l,l+1,k+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(norm,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  geo.setIndex(index);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,down);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function ramp(stops,h) {
  let i=0;
  while(i<stops.length-2 && h>stops[i+1][0]) ++i;
  return new THREE.Color(stops[i][1]).lerp(new THREE.Color(stops[i+1][1]),
    smooth(stops[i][0],stops[i+1][0],h));
}

const chick=group(scene,'golden-chick',V(125,266,0));
const body=group(chick,'body',V(125,177,0));
const head=group(body,'head',V(124,24,13));
const profile=[
  [-5,125,.05,.05,12],[-4,125,10,9,12],[0,125,21,19,13],
  [10,125,29,26,14],[23,125,33.5,30,14],[40,125,36.7,32,13],
  [54,126,41,35,10],[69,126.5,50,39,8],[86,126,61,46,5],
  [110,125.5,70.5,54,2],[140,125.5,80,61,0],[167,125,86,65,-1],
  [193,125,90,68,-2],[209,125,89.5,68,-2],[225,125,86.5,66,-2],
  [242,125,80,61,-1],[258,125,68,53,0],[272,125,47,37,1],
  [280,125,22,17,1],[282,125,.04,.04,1]
];
const plumage=[
  [-5,0xffe45b],[10,0xffdf44],[27,0xf9d13b],[46,0xf4af22],
  [62,0xf4a420],[83,0xffbb19],[98,0xfcc13b],[136,0xf3b740],
  [180,0xeead4a],[205,0xe6a146],[226,0xc28b37],[260,0xc58c35],[282,0xcd963c]
];
const bibColor=new THREE.Color(0xffce93), cheekColor=new THREE.Color(0xe99829);
const socketColor=new THREE.Color(0x796522);
function bodyColor(h,a,x) {
  const c=ramp(plumage,h),front=Math.max(0,Math.cos(a));
  const bib=smooth(88,120,h)*(1-.74*smooth(178,227,h))*
    Math.pow(front,1.65)*Math.exp(-Math.pow((x-129)/76,4));
  c.lerp(bibColor,bib*.94);
  const cheek=Math.exp(-Math.pow((h-54)/22,2)-Math.pow((x-125)/31,2))*front;
  c.lerp(cheekColor,cheek*.53);
  for(const [cx,cy] of [[103,25.6],[145.2,20.9]]) {
    const socket=Math.exp(-Math.pow((x-cx)/6.7,2)-Math.pow((h-cy)/7.4,2))*front;
    c.lerp(socketColor,Math.min(.93,socket*1.19));
  }
  return c;
}
const bodyRing=h=>profileRing(profile,h);
const torso=skin(body,'round-breast-and-back',58,282,108,bodyRing,bodyColor,[-5,282]);
skin(head,'crown-cheeks-and-throat',-5,58,42,bodyRing,bodyColor,[-5,282]);

function frontDepth(x,h) {
  const u=(x-sample(profile,h,1))/sample(profile,h,2);
  return sample(profile,h,4)+sample(profile,h,3)*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-u*u));
}
const eyes=group(head,'eyes',V(124,23,36));
for(const [side,x,h,turn] of [['left',103,25.6,-.53],['right',145.2,20.9,.48]]) {
  const z=frontDepth(x,h);
  const eye=group(eyes,side+'-eye',V(x,h,z));
  ellipsoid(eye,'olive-eye-rim',V(x,h,z+.3),[4.6,5.5,2.6],paint(0x776620),[0,turn,-.05]);
  ellipsoid(eye,'dark-eye',V(x,h-.1,z+1.65),[3.55,4.45,2.6],paint(0x17180c,.62),[0,turn,-.05]);
  ellipsoid(eye,'eye-glint',V(x-.8,h-1.65,z+3.9),[.65,.68,.35],paint(0x8c8555));
}
const mouth=group(head,'beak',V(122,39,44));
const lower=group(mouth,'lower-bill',V(122,40.5,44));
ellipsoid(lower,'lower-bill-volume',V(122.5,41,46),[8.3,2.6,6.7],paint(0xe49b2f),[.07,.015,.035]);
ellipsoid(mouth,'bill-opening',V(122,39.7,47.6),[9.2,1.05,6.4],paint(0xba7925),[.045,.015,.035]);
ellipsoid(mouth,'upper-bill',V(121.8,37.6,46.8),[10.6,2.9,8],paint(0xffca45),[.1,.015,.035]);

const times=[0,160,340,500,680,840,1020,1180,1200];
// Drop, sideways displacement, change in eye-line slope, and turn.
const headPoses=[
  [0,0,0,0],[.1,.2,.213,.036],[5,.2,.016,.01],[11.3,-.5,.137,.015],
  [6.5,0,.117,.038],[1.5,0,.025,.002],[5.9,.15,.203,.031],[10.4,.5,.048,.012]
];
head.matrixAutoUpdate=false;
const headBase=head.position.clone();
const torsoPos=torso.geometry.attributes.position;
const torsoNorm=torso.geometry.attributes.normal;
const restPos=torsoPos.array.slice(),restNorm=torsoNorm.array.slice();
const torsoOrigin=body.userData.origin.clone().sub(head.userData.origin);
function poseHead(drop,dx,slope,turn) {
  const c=Math.cos(turn),s=Math.sin(turn);
  head.matrix.set(
    c,0,s,headBase.x+dx,
    -slope,1,0,headBase.y-drop,
    -s,0,c,headBase.z,
    0,0,0,1
  );
  head.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate=true;
  // The throat follows the head, with the movement fading through the breast.
  for(let i=0;i<restPos.length;i+=3) {
    const x=restPos[i]+torsoOrigin.x,z=restPos[i+2]+torsoOrigin.z;
    const h=177-restPos[i+1];
    const w=1-smooth(58,206,h);
    const u=clamp((h-58)/148,0,1);
    const wy=6*u*(1-u)/148;
    const tx=(c-1)*x+s*z+dx,ty=-slope*x-drop,tz=-s*x+(c-1)*z;
    torsoPos.array[i]=restPos[i]+w*tx;
    torsoPos.array[i+1]=restPos[i+1]+w*ty;
    torsoPos.array[i+2]=restPos[i+2]+w*tz;
    const nx=restNorm[i],ny=restNorm[i+1],nz=restNorm[i+2];
    const a=1+w*(c-1),b=w*s;
    const px=a*nx+b*nz+w*slope*ny;
    const pz=-b*nx+a*nz;
    const py=(ny-wy*(tx*px+tz*pz))/(1+wy*ty);
    const inv=1/(Math.hypot(px,py,pz)||1);
    torsoNorm.array[i]=px*inv;
    torsoNorm.array[i+1]=py*inv;
    torsoNorm.array[i+2]=pz*inv;
  }
  torsoPos.needsUpdate=torsoNorm.needsUpdate=true;
}

const nearWing=[
  [72,65,.06,.06,51],[74,66,6.2,6.1,52],[79,67,11,10,53],
  [88,68.3,15,13.5,54],[99,68.7,18,15.3,54],
  [111,65,20.6,17.6,51],[126,60,22,20,46],[139,59,20.2,18,42],
  [151,60,15.6,15,39],[159,61.5,8.3,8.6,37],[162,62,.06,.06,36]
];
const farWing=[
  [62,213,.06,.06,48],[64,213,5.1,5.6,49],[71,213,9.7,10,50],
  [80,212,12.6,12,51],[91,209,14.7,13.6,52],[103,208,17,15,49],
  [117,210.5,19,17,45],[129,212,20,17.5,40],[138,212.6,17.8,16,35],
  [146,211,11.7,11.8,31],[151,209,5.4,5.3,29],[152.5,208,.06,.06,28]
];
// Tip height and x, wrist x, elbow x, bottom x and height, amount swung forward.
const leftTrack=[
  [72,65,68,59,62,162,1],[55,14,20,30,33,138,0],
  [87,52,59,55,54,174,.94],[93,19,26,29,30,168,.12],
  [87,19,25,34,35,162,.12],[77,58,66,56,55,169,1],
  [73,17,22,27,29,153,0],[98,39,47,49,49,180,.88]
];
const rightTrack=[
  [62,213,209,212,208,152.5,0],[77,155,159,183,182,163,1],
  [74,212,209,212,209,161,.04],[102,189,186,195,192,190,.86],
  [87,175,177,194,193,177,1],[75,214,209,211,208,162,0],
  [94,171,173,189,187,184,1],[92,211,207,211,204,182,.11]
];
function wingRing(side,key,u) {
  const track=side==='left'?leftTrack:rightTrack;
  if(key===0) {
    return side==='left'?profileRing(nearWing,72+90*u):profileRing(farWing,62+90.5*u);
  }
  const [top,tip,wrist,elbow,endX,bottom,near]=track[key];
  const path=[[0,tip],[.34,wrist],[.72,elbow],[1,endX]];
  const n=profileRing(nearWing,72+90*u),f=profileRing(farWing,62+90.5*u);
  const forward=Math.max(0,near-.12)*3*Math.sin(u*Math.PI);
  return [sample(path,u,1),mix(top,bottom,u),mix(f[2],n[2],near),
          mix(f[3],n[3],near),mix(f[4],n[4],near)+forward];
}
const wingAnimations=[];
const upperWings=[];
for(const side of ['left','right']) {
  const left=side==='left';
  const arm=group(body,side+'-wing',V(left?71:193,left?107:99,20));
  const upper=ellipsoid(arm,'upper-wing',V(left?66:199,left?122:116,24),
    [left?22:21,left?35:32,24],paint(0xeaaa28),[.24,0,left?-.19:.22]);
  const forearm=group(arm,'forearm',V(left?61:211,left?145:137,38));
  const wrist=left?105:96;
  const hand=group(forearm,'wingtip',V(left?68:209,wrist,51));
  const cut=left?(105-72)/90:(96-62)/90.5;
  const track=left?leftTrack:rightTrack;
  const upperStates=track.map((p,k)=>{
    if(k===0) return {pos:upper.position.clone(),q:upper.quaternion.clone(),scale:upper.scale.clone()};
    const sh=V(left?72:186,(left?105:102)+headPoses[k][0]*.65,18);
    const elbow=V(p[3],mix(p[0],p[5],.73),32);
    const direction=sh.clone().sub(elbow);
    const len=direction.length();
    const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),direction.normalize());
    return {
      pos:sh.lerp(elbow,.54).sub(arm.userData.origin),
      q,scale:new THREE.Vector3(mix(15.5,20,p[6]),len*.5+10,mix(18,22,p[6]))
    };
  });
  upperWings.push({upper,states:upperStates});
  function wingColor(u,a,x) {
    const rows=left?nearWing:farWing,h=mix(rows[0][0],rows.at(-1)[0],u);
    const c=new THREE.Color(0xffc43a).lerp(new THREE.Color(0xd99022),smooth(.30,1,u));
    const line=(left?103:96)+(x-(left?67:210))*(left?.57:-.33);
    const tip=1-smooth(line-5,line+4,h);
    const brown=new THREE.Color(0x694317).lerp(new THREE.Color(0x483012),
      smooth(rows[0][0]+5,line-3,h)*(.75+.2*Math.cos(a)));
    return c.lerp(brown,tip);
  }
  for(const [part,name,lo,hi,n] of [
    [forearm,'golden-lower-wing',cut,1,34],[hand,'rounded-brown-tip',0,cut,24]
  ]) {
    const mesh=skin(part,name,lo,hi,n,u=>wingRing(side,0,u),wingColor,[0,1]);
    const geo=mesh.geometry,positions=[],normals=[];
    // Use identical ring topology in each pose so the rounded tip stays joined at the wrist.
    for(let k=1;k<8;k++) {
      const shape=skin(part,name,lo,hi,n,u=>wingRing(side,k,u),wingColor,[0,1]);
      part.remove(shape);
      positions.push(shape.geometry.attributes.position);
      normals.push(shape.geometry.attributes.normal);
      shape.geometry.dispose();
    }
    geo.morphAttributes.position=positions;
    geo.morphAttributes.normal=normals;
    mesh.updateMorphTargets();
    mesh.frustumCulled=false;
    wingAnimations.push(mesh);
  }
}

const hemi=new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbeb,0xffdfb4,1.66);
scene.add(hemi,new THREE.AmbientLight(0xfff8e9,.42));
function light(x,y,z,color,power) {
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
light(-135,260,170,0xfff5d8,1.93);
light(140,95,96,0xfff3e8,.83);
light(80,175,-155,0xfff2cb,1.45);

const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2400,1600),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    vertexShader:`varying float height;
    void main(){
      vec4 world=modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.);
      height=world.y;
      gl_Position=projectionMatrix*viewMatrix*world;
    }`,
    fragmentShader:`varying float height;
    void main(){
      float fade=smoothstep(-4.,37.,height);
      vec3 c=mix(vec3(.64,.63,.65),vec3(1.,.997,.995),fade);
      c+=vec3(.035,.017,.047)*exp(-pow((height-18.)/6.,2.));
      gl_FragColor=vec4(sRGBTransferEOTF(vec4(c,1.)).rgb,1.);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }`
  }));
backdrop.name='white-studio-background';
backdrop.position.set(0,120,-340);
scene.add(backdrop);

const capture=new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(244,240,{
  minFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,magFilter:THREE.LinearFilter
});
const finish=new THREE.Scene();
const screenCam=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1,1,1,-1,0,2);
const finishMaterial=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthTest:false,depthWrite:false,uniforms:{picture:{value:capture.texture}},
  vertexShader:`varying vec2 st;
    void main(){ st=uv; gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,0.,1.); }`,
  fragmentShader:`uniform sampler2D picture;
    varying vec2 st;
    void main(){
      vec2 px=vec2(1./244.,1./240.);
      vec3 c=vec3(0.);
      for(int y=-1;y<=1;y++){
        for(int x=-1;x<=1;x++){
          float w=(x==0?2.:1.)*(y==0?2.:1.)/16.;
          c+=w*sRGBTransferOETF(texture2D(picture,st+1.23*px*vec2(float(x),float(y)))).rgb;
        }
      }
      vec2 p=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
      float d=fract(dot(mod(p,8.),vec2(.3125,.6875))+.25*mod(p.x*p.y,2.))-.48;
      c+=d*vec3(.048,.057,.072);
      c-=vec3(.003,.017,.004)*step(.37,d);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
    }`
});
finish.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),finishMaterial));

function render(t=0) {
  const ms=((t%1200)+1200)%1200;
  let a=0;
  while(a<7 && ms>=times[a+1]) a++;
  const b=(a+1)%8,f=smooth(times[a],times[a+1],ms);
  poseHead(...headPoses[a].map((v,j)=>mix(v,headPoses[b][j],f)));
  for(const mesh of wingAnimations) {
    const weights=mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
    weights.fill(0);
    if(a) weights[a-1]=1-f;
    if(b) weights[b-1]=f;
  }
  for(const {upper,states} of upperWings) {
    upper.position.lerpVectors(states[a].pos,states[b].pos,f);
    upper.quaternion.slerpQuaternions(states[a].q,states[b].q,f);
    upper.scale.lerpVectors(states[a].scale,states[b].scale,f);
  }
  renderer.setRenderTarget(capture);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(finish,screenCam);
}

window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[chick],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
